title: MMedAgent: Learning to Use Medical Tools with Multi-modal Agent
method: Instruction-tuned multimodal action planner and result aggregator using six medical tools over seven task types
evidence: Uses explicit Thought, Action, and Value trajectories
Covers grounding, segmentation, classification, report generation, retrieval, and VQA tools
Demonstrates that one MLLM can learn tool selection and aggregation
limitations: Multi-task evaluation is small relative to Med-CMR
Seven tasks do not cover Med-CMR's twelve imaging modalities
Specialist-tool errors and orchestration cost can compound
transfer_decision: Reuse action schema and aggregation concepts, but start with deterministic crop/zoom and add specialist tools only after error-driven oracle studies.
